summary.goal: Implement REST endpoints for plan workflow transitions (submit, approve, publish)
summary.context: These endpoints enforce the plan lifecycle state machine. Submit marks ready for review, approve locks the plan, publish releases for orchestrator.

acceptance_criteria.description: Published version returns plan_ref for orchestrator

steps.title: Define workflow state machine
steps.description: Create src/domain/workflow.ts with state transition logic and validation.

steps.title: Add submitted flag to version schema
steps.description: Extend PlanVersion with submitted_at timestamp for draft versions ready for review.

steps.title: Add approval metadata to version schema
steps.description: Extend PlanVersion with approval_info: { approver, approved_at } for accountability.

acceptance_criteria.description: approval_info has approver: string, approved_at: string

steps.title: Implement POST /plans/:id/versions/:v/submit
steps.description: Create endpoint to mark draft version as submitted for review.

acceptance_criteria.description: Returns 400 if version is not draft

steps.title: Implement POST /plans/:id/versions/:v/approve
steps.description: Create endpoint to approve and lock a version.

acceptance_criteria.description: Returns 400 if version is not submitted draft

steps.title: Implement POST /plans/:id/versions/:v/publish
steps.description: Create endpoint to publish approved version for orchestrator consumption.

acceptance_criteria.description: Returns 400 if version is not approved
Returns plan_ref in response for orchestrator

steps.title: Implement immutability enforcement
steps.description: Ensure approved/published versions cannot be modified via PUT endpoint.

acceptance_criteria.description: PUT /plans/:id returns 400 if latest version is approved
PUT /plans/:id returns 400 if latest version is published

steps.title: Add integration tests for workflow endpoints
steps.description: Write integration tests for all workflow transitions including error cases.
